_comment: gear_module=1.0, pinion=11T, spur=66T -> center_distance = 1.0*(11+66)/2 = 38.5mm. Meshing external gears turn OPPOSITE ways, so spur's ratio is negative and equal to -(pinion_teeth/spur_teeth). expected_interference_mm and multi_region_ok were both set from an ACTUAL measurement of this exact pair (check_collisions.py -- see the example's own README), not guessed: real involute teeth interpenetrate deeper than a simple press-fit backlash range (measured max penetration depth 1.383mm here, module-1 addendum-scale, not the ~0.1-0.5mm a bearing/shaft press fit would use), and a standard involute pair's contact ratio (>1 by design) means 2-3 adjacent tooth pairs are legitimately in simultaneous contact near the pitch point at any static pose -- confirmed 3 disjoint contact patches, all clustered within ~2.5mm x ~7mm near the line of centers, not scattered to unrelated geometry.
